title: Frontend heads the CPH page "County Parish Holding (CPH)" and lists it as "County Parish Holding number (CPH)"; Design release 1 words both differently

finding.frontend: The CPH page is headed "County Parish Holding (CPH)" — a noun phrase with no verb and initial capitals on each word — and the field carries the same string as its label (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/cph-number/copy/copy.en.js:2-6). On the Consignment addresses page the same thing is called "County Parish Holding number (CPH)", hinted "The County Parish Holding (CPH) number identifies the holding where the animals will be kept." (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses/copy/copy.en.js:9-12). So a trader meets three spellings of one term in two pages.
finding.prototype: Design release 1 heads the page with the instruction "Add the county parish holding number (CPH)" and labels the field beneath it simply "CPH number" (app/views/cph-number.html:33, app/views/partials/cph-number-input.html:9). On the addresses page the row is headed "County parish holding (CPH) number", hinted "The county parish holding (CPH) number identifies the holding where the animals will be kept." (app/data/consignment-address-sections.js:71-73). The term is lower case throughout, and "number" follows the bracketed abbreviation rather than preceding it.
finding.difference: Align the CPH wording with Design release 1 everywhere the term appears: head the page "Add the county parish holding number (CPH)" with the field labelled "CPH number", and label the addresses row and the check-your-answers row "County parish holding (CPH) number" with the matching lower-case hint. Three copy files — src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/cph-number/copy/copy.en.js:2-6, src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses/copy/copy.en.js:9-12 and src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/check-answers/copy/copy.en.js:85 — plus their Welsh counterparts. Note that the page heading also moves from a noun phrase to an instruction, which is what makes it a heading rather than a label; that is the substantive half of this change.
finding.falsifiedBy: Reading either heading in the two captured DOMs and finding them the same. fe-cph-number carries "County Parish Holding (CPH)" as its h1 and dr1-cph-number carries "Add the county parish holding number (CPH)".
finding.verification: Ran the falsifier: the h1 in capture/html/frontend/fe-cph-number.html is "County Parish Holding (CPH)", rendered as a govuk-label--l wrapped in an h1 and bound to countyParishHoldingCph, and the h1 in capture/html/prototype/dr1-cph-number.html is "Add the county parish holding number (CPH)" with the field legend "CPH number" beneath it. Checked every cited string at source and counted the lines by hand because an off-by-one here would land on a closing tag: src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/cph-number/copy/copy.en.js:2 and :4 give Frontend the same string for the title and the label; the addresses copy at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses/copy/copy.en.js:10-11 gives the row "County Parish Holding number (CPH)" and its hint; app/views/cph-number.html:33 is the h1 and app/views/partials/cph-number-input.html:9 is the legend, both root views with no release subfolder in the path; app/data/consignment-address-sections.js:72-73 is the row heading "County parish holding (CPH) number" and its lower-case hint. Read the rendered hub rows in fe-addresses-hub.html and fe-addresses-hub-complete.html against dr1-roles-and-addresses.html. Rubric 5 fired — a fourth place carries the term, see correction. The claim stands and the work is one file larger.
finding.correction: The claim stands and the difference slot has been widened by one file. It named two copy files; there are three. Frontend repeats the addresses row's spelling on the check-your-answers page — "County Parish Holding number (CPH)" at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/check-answers/copy/copy.en.js:85, rendered in the "Roles and addresses" card of the tag-stripped fe-check-answers.html — and Design release 1's own review page calls it "County parish holding (CPH) number" there too (dr1-review-notification). So the same rename lands in check-answers copy as well, and leaving it out would swap one inconsistency for another. Worth noting separately that the row heading, the page heading and the review label are separate strings in separate copy files on both sides, so this is three edits and their Welsh counterparts rather than one.
